intro.h2: Built down the road on North Federal Highway
paragraphs: H&H Signature Renovations is the owner-led team for bathroom remodeling in Lake Worth Beach, working from 1730 N Federal Hwy. One crew handles demolition, plumbing, electrical, waterproofing, tile, glass, cabinetry and finish work, and the same people run the job from day one to the walkthrough. The company takes full renovations only, not small repairs.

Before anyone opens a wall, you get a measured scope and a fixed price, not an allowance that grows later. services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Lake Worth Beach, and the rest of the house

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary baths, guest baths and powder rooms taken back to the studs. Pan slope, corners and every penetration are waterproofed before tile is set. Fixtures can move, including toilets and shower drains rerouted through the slab, and the crew finishes tile, glass, vanities and trim in house.

image.alt: Primary bathroom remodel with a freestanding tub, polished marble-look floor, dark vanity and backlit mirrors under a tray ceiling

items.name: Tub-to-Shower Conversion
items.blurb: The tub nobody uses comes out and a walk-in shower goes in. The work covers drain relocation, a new pan with curb or curbless entry, full waterproofing, tile, niche, bench and frameless glass. Grab-bar blocking goes into the wall while it is open.

image.alt: Frameless glass walk-in shower with marble tile and brass fixtures, built where an unused tub used to be

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Layout, cabinetry, countertops, islands, lighting, plumbing and electrical under one crew. Because most county homes sit on a concrete slab, the team checks early whether a sink or island can move. Salt air and humidity shape hardware and cabinet box choices too.

image.alt: Palm Beach Gardens kitchen remodel with white shaker cabinetry, a black quartz waterfall island and a cascading pendant cluster

items.name: Custom Closets and Built-Ins
items.blurb: Closets built as millwork to the opening you have, plus media walls, bookcases, window seats and fireplace surrounds. Wiring and venting are solved before the carpentry closes in. One Google reviewer said a fireplace bookcase with window seats beat the work of dozens of earlier contractors.

service_area.h2: From Lake Worth Beach to Boca Raton
service_area.text: Every city H&H serves is inside an hour of the shop at 1730 N Federal Hwy, and the team keeps it that way so a question asked on Tuesday gets answered on Tuesday. In Lake Worth Beach that covers downtown and Lake Avenue, the beach and Casino area, Bryant Park and the neighborhoods west toward Lake Osborne. Beyond the city, crews work across Palm Beach County.

faq.h2: Lake Worth Beach bathroom questions, answered

items.a: Yes. H&H offers a free in-home estimate with no obligation. The team walks the bathroom, measures it and talks through what is not working. You then get a written scope and a fixed price, set after selections are made, so the number does not creep up through allowances once work starts.

items.q: My house is in a historic district. Can I still remodel the bathroom?
items.a: Usually yes. Lake Worth Beach has six local historic districts, and the city requires a Certificate of Appropriateness before exterior work. A bathroom is interior, so most projects skip that step. If your plan changes a window or an exterior door, or vents through an outside wall, review applies and H&H builds it into the schedule.

items.q: Florida changed the permit law. Do I still need a permit?
items.a: Most likely. Under Florida House Bill 803, some residential projects under $7,500 may qualify for a permit exemption from July 1, 2026, but the city says it is not automatic and owners must apply first. A full bathroom renovation usually costs well above that, and H&H handles the permitting process either way.

items.q: Do you take small repair jobs?
items.a: No. H&H does full renovations only: primary baths, guest baths, powder rooms, tub-to-shower conversions, kitchens, closets and built-ins. Small repairs, maintenance and urgent repair calls are not offered, which keeps the crew focused on the projects it has scheduled and on finishing them well.

items.q: Can you work in my condo building?
items.a: Yes. H&H is insured in Florida and sends certificates naming your association or property manager on request. The team prepares the approval packet, reserves the service elevator and plans work around building hours. Shared waste stacks can limit how far a wet wall can move, so that gets checked at the first walkthrough.

final_cta.h2: Tell us what is not working in your bathroom
final_cta.text: Call (561) 888-4488 to book a free in-home estimate. Tristan's team will walk the room, confirm what review it needs and put a real scope and price in writing.
